frame: one adult sits at a plain table, front view, with one plain apple and one plain banana on the table.
sentence_nl: Ik eet een appel in plaats van een banaan.
sentence_en: I eat an apple instead of a banana.

frame: one adult in plain clothes with a small suitcase on the lap sits inside a moving vehicle and is seen side-on through its window or on its deck, three short speed lines behind it, the vehicle filling the width of the picture. Only the kind of vehicle changes.
sentence_nl: Wij gaan met de boot naar het eiland, maar zij reist met het vliegtuig.
sentence_en: We go to the island by boat, but she travels by plane.

frame: three identical plain cups drawn on a plain table, seen from slightly above and in front, same cup shape and size on the page, plain background. Only how the cups stand to one another changes.
sentence_nl: De kopjes staan naast elkaar, de auto's staan achter elkaar en de borden liggen op elkaar.
sentence_en: The cups stand side by side, the cars stand one behind the other and the plates lie on top of each other.

frame: one plain park bench, side view, on a flat ground line, with a small plain house behind it whose front door stands open and whose two windows show the room; five adults belong to the house and all five are in every drawing. Only how many of them sit on the bench, and how many are still inside, changes.
sentence_nl: Hij woont in zijn eentje, wij eten met zijn tweeën en zij gaan met zijn allen naar het park.
sentence_en: He lives by himself, we eat the two of us and they all go to the park together.

frame: a plain narrow stream with five flat stepping stones in a row from the left bank to the right bank, one adult with a bag, side view, same stream and same size on the page. Only how the adult crosses changes.
sentence_nl: Hij gaat stap voor stap over de stenen, maar zij springt in één keer over de beek.
sentence_en: He crosses the stones step by step, but she jumps over the stream in one go.

frame: two plain children and one plain swing.
sentence_nl: Wij schommelen om de beurt, maar jullie springen tegelijk.
sentence_en: We take turns on the swing, but you jump at the same time.

frame: two adults in plain clothes walk side by side along a flat path line, whole figures, side view, same size on the page, plain background. Only the way they are linked changes.
sentence_nl: Zij lopen hand in hand, maar het oude paar loopt arm in arm.
sentence_en: They walk hand in hand, but the old couple walks arm in arm.

frame: one adult, whole figure, side view, standing on a plain wooden floor line with one foot slightly forward, plain wall behind, same size on the page. Only what is on the feet changes.
sentence_nl: Zij loopt op blote voeten, maar hij loopt op sokken.
sentence_en: She walks barefoot, but he walks in socks.

frame: the front of a plain room corner, back wall in the middle, the ceiling line at the top and the floor line at the bottom, one plain round lamp with a small shade, same size on the page. Only the place where the lamp is fixed changes.
sentence_nl: Bij ons hangt de lamp aan de muur, bij hen hangt hij aan het plafond.
sentence_en: At our house the lamp hangs on the wall, at theirs it hangs from the ceiling.

frame: one adult man standing in a plain hallway beside an empty coat hook and the closed front door, front view, holding one plain mug in one hand, the other hand hanging down; same man, same face and hair, same hallway, same size on the page. Only his clothes change.
sentence_nl: Om zeven uur loopt hij nog in pyjama rond, om acht uur staat hij in pak bij de deur.
sentence_en: At seven he is still walking around in his pyjamas, at eight he stands at the door in a suit.

frame: one plain pan of water without a lid on one gas ring of a plain cooker, side view, nobody in the picture; same pan, same ring, same size on the page. Only the heat changes: the size of the flame, and what the water does with it.
sentence_nl: Eerst is de soep aan de kook, daarna staat hij op een laag pitje.
sentence_en: First the soup is on the boil, then it is on a low heat.

frame: one plain window with one side-hung casement that opens inward, the common Dutch window, in a plain wall, seen from inside the room, a plain sill below and the handle on the free edge; same window, same wall, same size on the page. Only how far the casement stands into the room changes.
sentence_nl: Het raam staat op een kier, maar in de zomer staat het wagenwijd open.
sentence_en: The window is ajar, but in summer it is wide open.
